verdict.rationale: USPTO's published pages say you must create a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication and verify your identity before you can access TEAS and Trademark Center, so the core filing flow is account-walled. The only documented keyless entry is a form-preview page plus pre-filing public search tools, which let a founder inspect forms and research marks but not start a filing. Missing for 10: any keyless or file-number path to actually begin or submit a filing; an unauthenticated draft or guest-filing mode; evidence that previewed forms carry over into the real flow.
